001package com.streamconverter.command.rule.impl.string;
002
003import com.streamconverter.command.rule.IRule;
004
005/**
006 * Trims leading and trailing whitespace from strings.
007 *
008 * <p>This rule removes whitespace characters from the beginning and end of the input string.
009 * Whitespace includes spaces, tabs, newlines, and other Unicode whitespace characters.
010 *
011 * <p>Examples:
012 *
013 * <ul>
014 *   <li>{@code " hello "} → {@code "hello"}
015 *   <li>{@code "\t\nworld\r\n"} → {@code "world"}
016 *   <li>{@code "already trimmed"} → {@code "already trimmed"}
017 * </ul>
018 *
019 * <p>Usage:
020 *
021 * <pre>{@code
022 * IRule rule = new TrimRule();
023 * IStreamCommand command = JsonWalker.create(TreePath.fromJson("$.name"), rule);
024 * }</pre>
025 *
026 * @since 1.0
027 */
028public class TrimRule implements IRule {
029
030  /** Creates a TrimRule instance. */
031  public TrimRule() {}
032
033  @Override
034  public String apply(String input) {
035    return input != null ? input.trim() : null;
036  }
037
038  @Override
039  public String toString() {
040    return "TrimRule{}";
041  }
042
043  @Override
044  public boolean equals(Object obj) {
045    return obj instanceof TrimRule;
046  }
047
048  @Override
049  public int hashCode() {
050    return TrimRule.class.hashCode();
051  }
052}
